## Summary

Typora-style code blocks implemented in `~/.hoocode/worktrees/noteapp/feat-codehide` (branch `agent/feat-codehide`, base `4104d2bb`, left **uncommitted** per constraints): fenced blocks are **hidden-by-default** (header only: lang + copy + new ▸/▾ chevron), expand on chevron/header-click/Enter, and expanded long lines **never wrap** — they scroll horizontally inside the page with per-block `dx` persisted like `table_x`. Mermaid blocks are exempt (stay open so their figure slot is untouched). Additive only: no Cargo.toml, no print paths, no signature changes to shared helpers.

## Behavior notes

- Effective-open = in `code_open` **or** cursor/revealed inside the body (clicked-line-reveal interplay); keyboarding into a folded body auto-expands; folding with cursor inside parks it on the header.
- Scroll: `frame_w = wide.min(width)` — container-inviolable by construction (never uses `room`, so Centered-wide settings can't spill code); thumb bar + 24px cursor-follow margin mirror tables.
- Copy button on the header copies full source while folded (`md::code_block` path unchanged).
